notes: Final tally: about 3,325 kcal (~13,900 kJ), roughly 525 above the 2,800 target. The targets arrived the next day.
Fat was the big miss: about 150 g against 70–80 g. The nuggets (~52 g), chocolate (~43 g) and doughnuts (~22 g) make up most of it.
Protein: about 120 g, two-thirds of the 180 g target. Carbs landed a little over at ~366 g.
Chocolate: ~835 kcal, about 25% of the day, and ~77 g of the day's ~159 g of sugar.
Accuracy: the pho and doughnuts are ±150 kcal each, and the three dipping sauces are assumed to be sweet ones at ~50 kcal each.

callout.title: Takeaway
callout.text: Swapping just the chocolate for two protein yoghurts would have saved ~500 kcal and ~40 g of fat and added ~25 g of protein, landing the day right around 2,800.

notes: Breakfast: a caramel latte sachet with ~4 teaspoons of sugar and a splash of milk. Only ~155 kcal, but ~27 g of sugar and almost no protein (~2 g). The sachet is already sweetened, so the extra sugar more than doubles it.
Lunch: a footlong Sweet Onion Chicken Teriyaki on malted rye. About 720 kcal and ~50 g of protein with only ~10 g of fat. A strong pick.
Afternoon coffee: another caramel latte, this time with 2 sugars instead of 4. About 125 kcal and ~19 g of sugar, saving ~8 g of sugar on the morning one. A good step down.
Pre-dinner snack: a peach & mango low-fat yoghurt. 88 kcal and ~11 g of protein, straight off the label.
Dinner: foil-baked peri-peri chicken (~600 g raw) on a veg medley, with 2 jasmine rice cups. About 1,260 kcal and ~151 g of protein with only ~17 g of fat. A big, clean feed.
Evening: another yoghurt and a tea with 2 sugars, about 140 kcal.
Final tally: about 2,490 kcal, ~227 g of protein, ~305 g of carbs and ~35 g of fat. Energy finished ~210 under the 2,700 floor; protein and carbs on target; fat low.
Sugar: about 115 g, mostly from four sweetened hot drinks.
Accuracy: the sachet and yoghurt numbers are from their labels; the chicken, rice, veg and drinks are estimates.

callout.title: Takeaway
callout.text: A big turnaround on Thursday: about 835 kcal less, ~107 g more protein and ~115 g less fat. The next easy win is the sugar in hot drinks: one teaspoon instead of two to four.

notes: Weigh-in: 114.7 kg, down 1.3 kg since Tuesday. Daily readings bounce 1–2 kg with water and food, so the trend matters more than any one day.
Breakfast: a peach & mango yoghurt and a caramel latte with 3 sugars. About 230 kcal and ~13 g of protein, with ~32 g of sugar.
Lunch: the same footlong Sweet Onion Chicken Teriyaki as yesterday, with a Coke No Sugar. About 720 kcal and ~50 g of protein with ~10 g of fat; the Coke adds nothing.
Afternoon: another peach & mango yoghurt, 88 kcal and ~11 g of protein.
Pre-walk coffee: caramel latte with 1 sugar this time, down from 3 this morning. About 108 kcal.
Day so far: about 1,150 kcal, ~75 g of protein, ~172 g of carbs and ~17 g of fat.
Still to go: about 1,550–1,750 kcal, ~105 g of protein, ~128–168 g of carbs and ~53–63 g of fat.

callout.title: Rest of today
callout.text: No rice at home, so dinner is the other 600 g of chicken on a double serve of veg (~1,040 kcal, ~150 g of protein). Veg is light on energy, so the day still needs ~600 kcal of carbs and fat: wholegrain wraps or toast with dinner, and peanut butter toast later, would close it.
